# Still Image Retouching & Finishing Skill for Muse

A provider-independent finishing craft reference for taking a captured, scanned, or rendered still image from intake to delivered file: nondestructive RAW development order, exposure and white balance, tone mapping and lens corrections, color-managed working spaces with ICC soft proofing and rendering intents, masking, repair and compositing, truthful retouching boundaries by genre (documentary, portrait, product, architecture, food, fine art), generative-repair disclosure and provenance rules, sharpening, noise, resampling, metadata (Exif, IPTC, XMP, C2PA), and destination-specific export recipes with a final QA checklist.
